locked_rules: The UI displays Step 17 rankings and cannot create, promote, or alter a PICK or PASS decision.
Recommendation thresholds, no-vig calculations, probability edges, and expected value remain owned by upstream model layers and are not recomputed in browser code.
Picks and PASS near misses must be visually separated.
Each finding must show model probability, no-vig market probability, probability edge, expected value, explanation, and market movement when available.
Player findings must drill into the player profile and game findings must drill into the NFL Games area.
The screen remains SHADOW_ONLY and non-actionable.
No wager placement, bankroll sizing, or staking controls are allowed.
